name: cognitive-code-analysis
description: Live cognitive complexity feedback for PHP while you type, powered by phpcca.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension runs the phpcca executable of the workspace, which is arbitrary code.

phpcca.enable.description: Show cognitive complexity diagnostics for PHP files.

phpcca.executable.markdownDescription: Path to the `phpcca` executable. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace folder. If the default `vendor/bin/phpcca` does not exist, `phpcca` from `PATH` is used.

phpcca.phpExecutable.markdownDescription: PHP binary used to run `phpcca` on Windows, where the script cannot be executed directly. Ignored on Linux and macOS.

phpcca.configFile.markdownDescription: Optional path to a phpcca config file, passed as `-c`. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace folder. If empty, `phpcca.yaml` in the workspace folder is used when present.

enumDescriptions: Analyse when a file is opened or saved.
Analyse when a file is opened and, debounced, while typing.

phpcca.debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds after the last keystroke before analysing (only for phpcca.runOn = type).

scripts.package: npm run compile && vsce package --out dist/
